// @path: src/lib/ops/reads.ts
// @expect: OPS-CHILD-RELATION
import "server-only";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";

// A notice is ADULT_READABLE, and which classes it went to is a pair of ids —
// but reaching the CHILDREN in those classes through it is the whole point of
// the relation rule. `class` is a child relation because Class is not an adult
// target, which the gate derives from the schema rather than from a list.
export async function whoWasTold(schoolId: string) {
  return db.notice.findMany({
    where: { schoolId },
    select: { title: true, classes: { select: { class: { select: { name: true, students: { select: { name: true } } } } } } },
  });
}
